runtime_changes: Replace the Time.time deadline with the original shouldKingBeHappy flag and a game-context-owned 10-second WaitForSeconds coroutine. Initial/extra budget events rearm it, ordinary spent-move events do not, and older delayed resumes are preserved.
Bind the actual MoveManager to the retained King. Start/append idle animation based on the native cached move count and stop flag instead of forcing a new idle clip during every HUD reset.

KingUi.BeSad also clears the cached move count. The first candidate omitted that native write and failed the real retry check; adding it restores the native forced idle restart after defeat while success continues through the queued idle path.

Idle routines honor the native stop flag at each delayed resume and clear their handle on exit. The ordinary improved branch stops the prior idle coroutine when starting another; the bonus branch retains its native behavior.
Count every accepted improved happy animation at the visual owner, including a normal goal win. Remove the former prediction-only increment and unsubscribe the reused view from retired level sources.
goal_check_routing: In the captured ordinary first-100 mode AnimationImprovementEnabled is true. The legacy GoalUi check-start happy/charger branch is therefore skipped; ordinary celebration is owned by the win transition and predictive King manager. Bonus boards do not use that ordinary speed-up branch.

native_reference.ports: Original MoveChanged, BeHappy, BeSad and EnableHappyAnimDelayed ARM64 bodies execute. Metadata/allocation, animation state and coroutine dispatch are supplied. Idle-start first-resume effects are supplied, not a native Unity scheduler.

idle_reference.method: Exact production IdleCycle body compiled with state/track/shuffle/wait ports; actual ARM64 IdleCycle.MoveNext and GetNextIdleLoop execute against equivalent ports. Shuffle permutations and engine scheduling are supplied.

offline_comparison.scope: Typed state, cached move resets, accepted-happy accounting, separate delayed resumes, and idle queue command/wait/stop behavior. Engine coroutine scheduling, animation ports and shuffle permutations are supplied in offline comparison; real Unity owner execution is verified separately.

The supplied old Unity screenshot has the same box footprint/counters but additional top-board powers and different pieces; this capture does not establish that old picture as the original app or as an initial board.

The canonical test was not weakened. A separate natural run completes level 80 in 20 moves and opens level 81.

intermediate_candidate_regression.failure: The initial candidate missed the native BeSad cached-move reset and failed fresh-idle-after-retry. The final candidate includes that write and passes the unchanged formal check.

composition.performance: Only native low-frequency move events and animation/coroutine transitions are added; existing cached rig/mesh evaluation is unchanged. The 10-second wait and iterator allocations follow the original owner.

limits: Offline comparison executes the listed original ARM64 state/iterator bodies with explicit engine, metadata, allocation, track and shuffle ports. It is not execution of the complete original Unity/Spine engine or scheduler.

The private observed Unity probe deliberately triggers budget events and happy callbacks, then uses actual quit/retry owners. It is a scoped state/owner test, not normal touch or a natural level solve. Its 720x1600 render captures use a test target and are not layout-parity evidence.

The separate unobserved ordinary natural runs use recorded tutorial/hint/board gestures and no arranged powers. The snapshot run only adds an Editor-side capture after move two; its production runtime has no observation hooks.
The legacy level-80 required-shuffle scenario remains failing on both baseline and fixed source because this run never shuffles; that failure is retained explicitly.
This revision has not been rebuilt or executed on Android yet. Full original-app image/audio/input parity and natural all-100-level completion remain unverified.
